products.title: Balm Besties
products.body_html:
All three custom-color balms, together in one obsession-worthy set. Clear to custom in a swipe. This colour-changing formula reacts to your natural pH levels to create the perfect custom pink shade that's made just for U. Swipe it on clear and watch the colour bloom. Multi-pearl flakes add shine and reflective dimension while the lightweight conditioning balm wraps lips in glossy moisture for a soft, comfortable feel.

Available in 3 shades: crystal clear, sheer pink, or holographic blue. All three transform into your own perfect custom pink flush. Infused with pH-reactive pigments for personalised colour and a conditioning balm base for smooth, comfortable wear.

Bundle Includes:
- Clearly Cute: Custom crystal clear
- Pink Mood: Custom sheer pink
- Holo Bestie: Custom holographic blue

products.title: Double Kiss
products.body_html:
Can’t choose between Hannah and Miley? Get both lip kits in one set. Bold and pearlized for your pop star side, soft and creamy for your everyday life — the best of both worlds on your pout.
Set Includes:
- Rock Sensation Lippie Kit
   - Lippie Pencil in Rock Out The Show: Auburn
   - Lippie Stix in Smooth Talkin’ (Pearlized): Warm peach with silver
- Malibu Dreaming Lippie Kit
   - Lippie Pencil : Take It Slow: Rich rose
   - Lippie Stix: This Is the Life (Creme): Warm rose

products.title: Rock Sensation
products.body_html:
Rock out the show in Hannah's signature lip combo. This limited-edition warm peachy-nude kit is inspired by the pop star herself. Our bestselling Lippie Pencil defines lips with a creamy, long-lasting formula, while our Lippie Stix delivers rich Pearlized pigment in one swipe. 

Lippie Pencil  – Define (or overline) your lips with our creamy, long-lasting formula that creates the cleanest lines and minimizes feathering. Plus, it’s sharpenable!
Lippie Stix - Get a flawless pout with our long-lasting Matte  formula for rich pigment in one swipe! Infused with Vitamin E, Mango, Avocado, and Shea Butter for a moisturizing boost + comfy feel.

Kit Includes:
- Lippie Pencil in Rock Out The Show: Auburn
- Lippie Stix in Smooth Talkin’ (Pearlized): Warm peach with silver

products.title: Malibu Dreaming
products.body_html:
Stay lowkey gorgeous as Miley with this warm rose lip combo. This limited-edition kit is inspired by Miley’s laid-back Malibu vibe. Our bestselling Lippie Pencil defines lips with a creamy, long-lasting formula, while our Lippie Stix delivers rich Creme pigment in one swipe.

Lippie Pencil  – Define (or overline) your lips with our creamy, long-lasting formula that creates the cleanest lines and minimizes feathering. Plus, it’s sharpenable!
Lippie Stix - Get a flawless pout with our long-lasting Matte formula for rich pigment in one swipe! Infused with Vitamin E, Mango, Avocado, and Shea Butter for a moisturizing boost + comfy feel!

Kit Includes:
- Lippie Pencil : Take It Slow: Rich rose
- Lippie Stix: This Is the Life (Creme): Warm rose

products.title: Best of Both Worlds
products.body_html:
Say whaaaat? This limited-edition palette celebrates 20 years of the Disney series that defined a generation! Choose your side with 16 ultra-pigmented shades in two halves: bold brights inspired by Hannah Montana's pop star persona on the left, everyday neutrals inspired by Miley Stewart's ordinary girl life on the right. Our ultra-pigmented pressed powder formula is long-lasting, applies evenly and blends like a dream for effortless application.

Features 5 finishes: Matte, Metallic, Matte Sparkle, Pearlescent Glitter and NEW Chrome Metallic.

Shade Descriptions:
- Parade of Diamonds: White silver
- Backstage Pass: Baby pink
- Sweet Niblets!: Mint green
- Ordinary Girl: Warm beige
- Find Your Way: Warm lilac
- Lilly: Golden metallic
- Seaview High: Saddle brown
- Miles: Seafoam green
- Secret Identity: Pinky magenta
- Guitar Cutie: Hot pink
- Ollipop: Rich blue
- Nashville: Cocoa brown
- Sold-Out Tour: Pinky violet
- #1 Hits: Smoky gunmetal
- Robby Ray: Blackened brown
- Two Lives: Matte teal

products.title: Secret Superstar
products.body_html: Keep your pout pop star-ready, wherever you go. Our ALL-NEW two-tone shimmering lip gloss that hydrates lips and goes on clear to create a multidimensional hi-shine finish that's collection-worthy. The star-shaped keychain keeps it with you always, at home or away on tour. Infused with Jojoba Oil, Argan Oil, and Vitamin E to hydrate and condition lips all day.

products.title: A Girl Like Me
products.body_html:
Miley’s everyday lip look in one set. The Keeping It Real gloss and Malibu Dreaming lip kit for soft, effortlessly beautiful pout energy — because just an ordinary girl can look anything but.
Set Includes:
- Shimmer Lip Gloss Keychain in Keeping It Real: clear with aqua + violet shimmer
- Malibu Dreaming Lippie Kit
   - Lippie Pencil in Take It Slow: Rich rose
   - Lippie Stix in This Is the Life (Creme): Warm rose

products.title: Being Hannah
products.body_html:
Hannah Montana’s signature lip look in one set. The Secret Superstar gloss and Rock Sensation lip kit for full pop star pout energy — pearlized, pigmented, and completely obsession-worthy.
Set Includes:
- Shimmer Lip Gloss Keychain in Secret Superstar: clear with silver + pink shimmer
- Rock Sensation Lippie Kit
   - Lippie Pencil in Rock Out The Show: Auburn
   - Lippie Stix in Smooth Talkin’ (Pearlized): Warm peachy nude with silvery pearl

products.title: Just An Ordinary Girl
products.body_html:
Channel your inner Miley with this everyday-glam set. The palette, gloss, and lip kit for a softer, more lowkey look — proof that ordinary girls are anything but ordinary.

Set Includes:
- Best of Both Worlds Eyeshadow Palette
- Shimmer Lip Gloss Keychain in Keeping It Real: clear with aqua + violet shimmer
- Malibu Dreaming Lippie Kit
   - Lippie Pencil in Take It Slow: Rich rose
   - Lippie Stix in This Is the Life (Creme): Warm rose

products.title: Star on Stage
products.body_html:
Live your best Hannah Montana life with this show-stopping set. Everything you need to rock out the show in full pop star style — the palette, gloss, lip kit, and body glitter that’ll have you shining like stage lights from every angle.

Set Includes:
- Best of Both Worlds Eyeshadow Palette
- Shimmer Lip Gloss Keychain in Secret Superstar: clear with silver + pink shimmer
- Rock Sensation Lippie Kit
   - Lippie Pencil in Rock Out The Show: Auburn
   - Lippie Stix in Smooth Talkin’ (Pearlized): Warm peach with silver
- Roll-On Body Glitter in Stage Lights: Opal pink shift
